01 / 05

PartyMeter

Enhancing user engagement and offline dining experiences. PartyMeter lets users log, track and redeem party commitments within their social circles.

Client
Proposal sent to EazyDiner
Scope
Proposal writing
Research
UI/UX writing
Web development
Technical writing
Date
June 2025
View proposal document ↗ Visit website ↗
01

Logging commitments

  • Record party promises made by friends or colleagues — “I’ll give you a party for my promotion.”
  • Friends send requests; once accepted, the count shows on the host’s public profile.
  • Commitments stay visible to the relevant circle — a college group or workplace.
02

Tracking & public accountability

  • A dashboard shows pending party commitments for each user within their circles.
  • Visibility across the circle nudges people to actually keep their promises.
03

Redeeming commitments

  • Once enough requests pile up (e.g. 10 friends), the host redeems through EazyDiner at participating restaurants.
  • Partner restaurants offer group discounts or special packages.
04

Offline gathering

  • The app helps pick dates and times, handing off to EazyDiner’s existing service for a seamless dining experience.

The flow

Request → track → redeem at a partner restaurant.

02 / 05

Instamalt

A fictional brand and logo for a sweet malted-milk hot drink powder, created for a branding-research competition. Milk, wheat and energy set the design direction.

Scope
Graphic design
Brand story
Marketing
Content writing
Date
April 2022
Context
Competition entry

Don’t just wake up “Dazzle”

MALTMILKENERGY

Background

The brief: research a malt-based drink powder and propose a new logo aligned to an existing brand, with a full branding system. The choice landed on “INSTAMALT”.

Concept story

The tagline promises more than alertness — energy and excellence — for parents who want the best start for their child, and kids who want to stand out. Box components and the logo follow the same story.

Instamalt does not exist in the real market. The Kellogg’s name is used only to showcase branding work for educational purposes; no copyright is held over it.

Scope

Concept story

The name and mark come from admiration, love and a harbour for hearts. Ahsing-inspired letterforms give a modern, cleaner shape with an organic touch, so the classic style remains.

01Emotional appeal

“Heart” evokes warmth, love and thoughtfulness — essential qualities for a gifting platform.

02Imagery of safety & care

“Harbor” suggests shelter and protection — gifts from the portal bring comfort and meaningful connection.

Install Motors on Drone Arm

A work-instruction manual for installing a Brushless DC (BLDC) motor assembly onto a drone arm — written so the procedure is safe, repeatable and reliable for the UAV.

Type
Mechanical documentation · Work sample
Scope
Mechanical documentation
Engineering
Technical writing
Date
March 2025
View full document ↗

Why it matters

Adherence to the SOP is critical for operational safety, reliability and performance of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle. Every step pairs an instruction with a labelled diagram so nothing is left to interpretation.

4.2 · Tools required
IDToolQtySize
T-01Hex driver (Allen key)12.5 mm
T-02Torque wrench (optional)1—
T-03Wire strippers / cutters1—
T-04Soldering iron & solder1—
2.1 · Position the motor

Place the BLDC motor (A) onto the motor mount (B) and align the mounting holes (C) with the mount.

2.2 · Secure the motor

Insert M3×8 mm screws through the mount, hand-tighten, then repeat in a cross pattern for even pressure.

Critical · screws must not touch the copper windings
